changes: Adds TV Manual Media Import from an external folder for an entire season or a single episode from the Automation item view.
Adds a non-destructive Preview Import step that maps source files to episode metadata, canonical destination names, incoming/existing quality decisions, and quality-cutoff outcomes before commit.
Routes committed manual imports through the existing transactional Smart Import rename/move and final no-downgrade revalidation path instead of creating a parallel organizer.

Immediately reconciles Automation library quality state and Wanted targets after successful external imports so satisfied missing/upgrade targets disappear without another download, restart, or library scan.
regression_guards: Manual Media Import is explicitly user-selected and currently limited to TV items; season imports map only episodes present in current Automation metadata and single-episode imports remain exact-target bounded.
Preview never moves or deletes media and never writes the Automation library record; commit always rebuilds and revalidates the plan from current state.

Existing library files are replaced only when the incoming media is provably better under the selected quality profile; equal, worse, duplicate, or indeterminate-quality media keeps the existing file.
Import commit re-builds the plan and revalidates the physical destination immediately before transaction commit so Preview cannot bypass live no-downgrade protection.

v3.6.33 TV edition search aliases, v3.6.32 Automation target-integrity/no-downgrade protections, and the accepted v3.6.28-v3.6.31 SAB/download-control stack remain intact except for required v3.6.34 identity markers.
name: Manual Media Import & Wanted Reconciliation
